environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind CloudFront distribution with Origin Access Control (OAC) configured. The origin ALB is in a private subnet with security group restricting inbound traffic to the CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing) only. CloudFront distribution has a custom origin request policy that strips all headers except Host, Content-Type, and X-Session-Id before forwarding to origin. The distribution's cache behavior has a CloudFront Function attached at viewer-request stage that validates the request path against an allowlist regex pattern ^/api/(auth|content/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+|health)$ and returns 403 for non-matching paths. The /api/debug/* path pattern is not in the allowlist. Additionally, the Fargate task role has no sts:AssumeRole permission (credentials are injected via ECS task credential provider with a scoped-down policy), and the container runs with read-only root filesystem.

cloudfront.origin_request_policy: custom - forwards only Host, Content-Type, X-Session-Id headers

config.security_group: inbound restricted to com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing prefix list only
config.network: ALB in private subnet, no public IP, no direct internet access to origin
config.task_role: no sts:AssumeRole, scoped to cloudfront:CreateSignedUrl equivalent only
